name: This Book
description: One book. The campaign lives here.

pages.title: This book
pages.text:
This is the **Whisker Codex**. One book. Right-click always opens these pages: what the sky used to be, how it came apart, what you do next, who kept the Loom.

There is no Shift-click mode. There is no second story hidden behind a modifier. **The Old Sky** chapter fills in as you seat Strands — the tribes only talk once you have kept their promise.

pages.title: The assignment list
pages.text:
The **Grave** key (backtick `` ` ``) opens the live assignment list — FTB Quests, checkmarks and rewards. That list is the **same campaign**, not a second book.

Come here to learn the braid and the old world. Open Grave when you want the next task in your hand. Both screens now sit on the same atlas: the hanging pads, the wheel, the cut in the teal.

pages.title: What you are mending
pages.text:
You are not putting continents back. You are teaching nine Strands to agree again, one pad at a time. A seated token is a promise kept. A thinner Fray is the sky noticing.

When every Clowder has rewoven, the column over the Dock turns to lit thread. The world does not snap back. It learns to hold.

pages.title: The chapters
pages.text:
**The Work** is this: what to do with your hands. **The Cut** is how the sky came apart. **The Old Sky** is the world that hung — it unlocks as Strands seat, not all at once. **The Loom Braid** is the campaign in order. **Nine Tribes** is who kept each pull. **Snapped Guardians** is what the Cut left feral.

Start here. Read *The old world* next if you want the story before the checklist.

pages.title: Keep it in public
pages.text:
A Clowder shares a pad, shares quests, and shares Loom Tension. When one of you seats a Strand, all of you hear it. The Fray over the Dock thins in public. Mending that stays a secret is just a nicer hammock.

Help the next Clowder when your Strand of the sky has closed. That is the whole of the method.
